prompts.text: # hub-only-look — apps take their appearance from axHub, period Brett's rule (Nov 1 2026, verbatim): "The apps should only get appearance from axhub period." Also: "if you select design package in one app it changes it for all! Any theme change applies to all." Today the look is the shared document `shared/settings/appearance.json` on axHub's data server (framework `HubAppearanceSource`, runtime `attachAppearanceSource` / `applyAppearance` / `pushAppearance`). PR #224 (1156332c) already made a hub-applied look bring the console back to its Main tab and closed the Active assets pane by default…
